entities.name: Dock 13
entities.source_summary: Fixer-run storefront built around repackaging unwanted dockside salvage, with an occasional Night Market at the same location.
entities.catalogue_note: The source establishes deliberately miscellaneous salvage but not stable product categories. The audit's general/electronics/weapons/fashion departments are therefore not converted into a persistent catalogue assortment.

audit.note: The storefront remains commerce, but its source-defined dross/salvage identity is preserved without inventing exact shelf items. The occasional Night Market is represented separately.
